description:
The silent, wireless optical mouse of the valued Ugreen brand is a computer accessory that will be appreciated by many users of computer equipment.
The ergonomic model MU101 has been profiled in such a way that it can be used comfortably.
The product is equipped with 2 silent buttons and a scroll wheel with a precise pitch.
The roller also serves as a third button. The computer mouse from Ugreen has a sensor whose sensitivity can be set on one of 4 levels - 1000, 1600, 2000, 4000 DPI.
Thanks to this, the model will work both during office work, browsing the Internet, and while playing video games.
